description_good_justification: The site home page (https://julianmaurin.github.io/PullRequestPilot/) and the README say what the app does: live views of GitHub pull request review queues in the menu bar, desktop widgets and notifications.
interact_justification: Obtain: Mac App Store link on https://julianmaurin.github.io/PullRequestPilot/ and in the README. Feedback: https://julianmaurin.github.io/PullRequestPilot/support links to https://github.com/JulianMaurin/PullRequestPilot/issues. Contribute: https://github.com/JulianMaurin/PullRequestPilot/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_justification: https://github.com/JulianMaurin/PullRequestPilot/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md describes the process: an issue first for larger changes, a fork, a pull request against main, CI must pass, maintainer review.
contribution_requirements_justification: https://github.com/JulianMaurin/PullRequestPilot/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md lists the requirements: tests for new behaviour, make build and make test clean, the SwiftLint rules, the conventions in CLAUDE.md and the commit format.
documentation_basics_justification: README (https://github.com/JulianMaurin/PullRequestPilot#readme) covers features, requirements and building; https://julianmaurin.github.io/PullRequestPilot/support has setup steps and an FAQ.
documentation_interface_justification: The interface is the app's UI and the GitHub search queries it runs: the README features section, https://julianmaurin.github.io/PullRequestPilot/support, and https://julianmaurin.github.io/PullRequestPilot/github-api-usage, which lists exactly what the app sends to GitHub.
sites_https_justification: github.com, julianmaurin.github.io and apps.apple.com are served over HTTPS only.
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests (https://github.com/JulianMaurin/PullRequestPilot/issues): searchable, addressable by URL, open to anyone with a GitHub account.
english_justification: All documentation is in English, and reports are accepted in English.
maintained_justification: Regular commits and App Store releases; see https://github.com/JulianMaurin/PullRequestPilot/commits/main and https://julianmaurin.github.io/PullRequestPilot/changelog
repo_track_justification: Git records every change with its author and date.
repo_interim_justification: Every change is committed to main between releases, not only releases.
version_unique_justification: Each App Store release has its own MARKETING_VERSION, declared once in project.yml.
version_semver_justification: Versions are X.Y.Z; make metadata-lint rejects anything else.
release_notes_vulns_justification: No publicly known vulnerability has been fixed so far; the changelog would name any.
report_responses_justification: Every report so far has been acknowledged by the maintainer: https://github.com/JulianMaurin/PullRequestPilot/issues?q=is%3Aissue
enhancement_responses_justification: Every enhancement request so far has been answered: https://github.com/JulianMaurin/PullRequestPilot/issues?q=is%3Aissue
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: GitHub private vulnerability reporting at https://github.com/JulianMaurin/PullRequestPilot/security/advisories/new, described in https://github.com/JulianMaurin/PullRequestPilot/blob/main/.github/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability report has been received; SECURITY.md commits to a reply within a week.
build_justification: make build (XcodeGen, then xcodebuild), documented in the README; CI rebuilds every commit.
build_floss_tools_justification: Mac apps need Xcode, which is free of charge but proprietary. The Swift compiler, SwiftLint and XcodeGen are FLOSS.
test_justification: About 800 Swift Testing tests in PullRequestPilotTests, run with make test as the README documents.
test_invocation_justification: make test wraps xcodebuild test, the standard way to run an Xcode project's tests.
test_most_justification: Line coverage is about 46% of the app target: models, view models and the GitHub client are tested, SwiftUI views and the widget mostly are not. CI reports the figure on every run.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: https://github.com/JulianMaurin/PullRequestPilot/actions/workflows/ci.yml runs the tests on every push and pull request.
test_policy_justification: https://github.com/JulianMaurin/PullRequestPilot/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md: every change in behaviour comes with a test that fails without it.
tests_are_added_justification: Recent fixes and features landed with tests; see https://github.com/JulianMaurin/PullRequestPilot/commits/main/PullRequestPilotTests
warnings_justification: Swift 6 with complete strict concurrency, warnings treated as errors (SWIFT_TREAT_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS), and SwiftLint --strict with project rules.
warnings_fixed_justification: The build fails on any warning, so none can be merged.
warnings_strict_justification: Every compiler and SwiftLint warning is an error.
know_secure_design_justification: The maintainer applies least privilege (App Sandbox, minimal entitlements, read-only access to user-picked folders), keeps the token only in the Keychain, and passes user input to GitHub as GraphQL variables rather than interpolated strings.
know_common_errors_justification: Injection (GraphQL variables), credential leaks (Keychain only, gitleaks, push protection), sandbox escapes (entitlement checks in CI), data races (Swift 6 strict concurrency).
crypto_published_justification: No custom cryptography; TLS comes from the operating system through URLSession.
crypto_call_justification: Only the system's TLS and Keychain are used.
crypto_keylength_justification: The app sets no key lengths; the system TLS stack does.
crypto_working_justification: The app implements no cryptographic mechanism; the system TLS stack does.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: The app implements no cryptographic mechanism; the system TLS stack does.
crypto_pfs_justification: The app implements no key agreement; the system TLS stack does.
crypto_password_storage_justification: The app stores no passwords for users; the user's own GitHub token goes to the Keychain.
crypto_random_justification: The app generates no keys or nonces.
delivery_mitm_justification: Delivered through the Mac App Store (signed, over HTTPS); source over HTTPS or SSH from GitHub.
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hash is fetched over HTTP; CI verifies the SHA-256 of every tool it downloads over HTTPS.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: None reported; SECURITY.md describes the process.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: gitleaks scans the whole history in CI (https://github.com/JulianMaurin/PullRequestPilot/actions/workflows/security.yml) and in a pre-commit hook; GitHub push protection is on.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (security-extended) on every push, pull request and weekly: https://github.com/JulianMaurin/PullRequestPilot/actions/workflows/codeql.yml. SwiftLint with project rules on every build.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Findings are fixed or triaged before release; none are open.
static_analysis_often_justification: On every push and pull request.
dynamic_analysis_justification: No fuzzer or dynamic scanner; the test suite is the only dynamic check.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: Swift is memory-safe; the project has no C or C++.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Tests run the Debug configuration, with assertions, preconditions and Swift's runtime exclusivity checks enabled.
